verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost the same, and both are broken. Each drops the full-bleed pizza background, leaving a small photo and a thin orange headline band floating on plain white. Roughly half the tall canvas is empty white space (at the top, between the band and the photo, and at the bottom), and the headline is small for the format. The band no longer overlaps the image, so the original's layered feel is gone. A is slightly better balanced vertically, with about 170px of white above and 183px below, while B sits higher with about 150px above and 200px below. B is no better in any other way.
